answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain proportional influence. As the delta of required capital scales exponentially, the tide of malicious agents is effectively blocked by an economic jetty of burnt value. An attacker must incur substantial, non-recoverable losses to forge identities, ensuring that network weight remains tethered to committed financial resource rather than mere computational replication.
